objective: Close the Launcher human-UX slice: clipboard Quick Preview must open the full preview reliably, the footer must not visually overflow when many actions exist, and the launcher must keep local-source hot paths explicit.

criteria.promise: Clipboard cards expose a visible Quick Preview button and hover affordance that expands the full detail inside the launcher without running the clip or replacing the clipboard.
The footer has full, compact and minimal layouts so quick actions do not overflow or look broken when the selected item adds primary/actions/settings controls.
Launcher input routing keeps clipboard mode lightweight and does not wake Brain/vault/local-source work unless the user asks for those surfaces.

verification_gates.procedure: Run CommandViewUXTests and inspect CommandView preview ordering/selection clearing.
verification_gates.expected: The selected card is set before expansion and stale model.selected is not used to clear the preview.

verification_gates.procedure: Run CommandViewUXTests and inspect CommandView footer ViewThatFits variants.
verification_gates.expected: The footer includes a minimal fallback with icon-only controls and a Voice menu.
Clipboard mode and ordinary launch do not touch vault, graph, processes or local sources unless explicitly requested.

recon_evidence: CommandView, launcher input tests and UX wave docs were inspected. The reported MacBook issue maps to preview clearing by stale selection and to a footer without a third fallback layout.
